items.quote: ABSOLUTELY AMAZING! came out within an hour to fix the key I broke and program the new key fob to my car. Super nice and good quality work and supply!
I recommend this place, very professional. I was there to make some duplicates, and the gentleman treated me with a lot of respect and professionalism.
My mechanic was not able to program my chip key to my SUV, so he suggested I go to Gerald's, and within 15 minutes of arriving my new key was programmed and I was happy.
